approvals.sellers.title: Seller applications
approvals.sellers.lead: Accounts that applied to sell. Approving one makes it a seller whose store may trade; rejecting it lets the applicant file a corrected application.
approvals.couriers.title: Courier applications
approvals.couriers.lead: Accounts that registered a vehicle in the courier app. Approving one makes it a courier and asks the fleet to activate its driver.
approvals.status.label: Show
approvals.keys.label: Keyboard
approvals.empty.pending: No application waits for a decision.
approvals.field.name: Name
approvals.principal.none: None yet: the account has never signed in
approvals.profile.failed: The profile could not be read
approvals.decided.rejected: Rejected. The applicant may file a corrected application.
approvals.confirm.approveSeller.title: Approve {name}?
approvals.confirm.approveSeller.body: The account becomes a seller and its store is verified, so the merchant may list products and trade from now on. Its sessions carry the new role from their next renewal.
approvals.confirm.rejectSeller.title: Reject {name}?
approvals.confirm.rejectSeller.body: The application is marked rejected. The account keeps its role and may file a corrected application from the seller web.
approvals.confirm.approveCourier.title: Approve {name}?
approvals.confirm.approveCourier.body: The account becomes a courier, and identity asks the fleet to activate its driver so it can take jobs.
approvals.done.approvedCourier: {name} is a courier now, and the fleet has activated the driver.
approvals.note.unplaced: Its store address could not be placed on the map, so no courier can be sent there until it is.
approvals.failure.refused: Identity refused, and nothing changed. The list has been read again.
approvals.failure.noVehicle: This account has filed no vehicle, so it cannot be approved. Nothing changed; the courier registers a vehicle in the courier app first.
approvals.failure.fleetUnavailable: The account is a courier now, but the fleet could not be told to activate its driver. Approve again once the fleet answers; nothing will be duplicated.
approvals.failure.fleetRefused: Nothing changed: the fleet refused to activate this driver ({code}). Approving again will not help until that is dealt with.
